data.name: Green Tea Field Mayhem
data.detailed_description:
Teatime Tussle: Defend the Leaf! (Game Description)

Set against the beautiful Boseong Green Tea Fields of South Korea, this is a thrilling multiplayer psychological hide-and-seek game. Choose your role: become an adorable Tea Fairy protecting the tea leaves from mischievous Dokkaebi, or be a Dokkaebi tasked with stealing them.

Gameplay

This game reinterprets the Boseong Green Tea Fields into a sprawling, intricate multiplayer maze focused on strategic hide-and-seek, psychological warfare, stealth, and collection.

The Tea Fairy

  • Vulnerability & Stealth: The Fairy's figure is easily exposed over the maze walls, making their position quickly visible. They can crouch to conceal their appearance, but this significantly reduces their movement speed.

  • Mission: Chase and catch all the Dokkaebies, before they manage to steal the required tea leaves.

The Dokkaebi

  • Concealment & Risk: Dokkaebies are completely hidden by the maze walls. They can Jump to secure vision beyond the maze, but this action risks being instantly spotted by the Fairy.

  • Mission: Collect all the mission tea leaves without being caught.

Core Feature

The key enjoyment lies in the strategic choice and execution of actions by all players, utilizing the constant risk-reward structure between concealment and exposure. Despite the cute graphics, experience the thrilling psychological battle that feels like a combination of hide-and-seek and Whack-A-Mole through momentary exposure.
